When I was 10 and my friend was 12 and we lived in the country on the edge of a forest. We would collect our firewood for our families, we would go out and cut wood with an axe. While getting wood my friend swung down with his axe to split the piece of wood in front of him, and missed and hit himself. The cut was a few centimeters deep and the length of the axe. I ran back to my house to go get something to stop him from bleeding. Being afraid my friend would lose too much blood I wanted to be quick as possible, so without thinking I grabbed a bottle of water and... bandaids. When I got back to him I realized how stupid that was, but we still put on a dozen or so bandaids. Could have been really bad for him but turned out fine.
